// diagnostic

L2201

Public API item `{name}` has no documentation

What

Public API item `{name}` has no documentation

Why

Generated reference documentation needs a summary for every public API item so users can find and understand the supported surface.

Fix

add a `///` summary before `{name}`, or remove `pub` when it is not part of the public API.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L2201: tests/ui_lint/undocumented_public_api.warn.

Warning [L2201] (undocumented_public_api): public API item `undocumented` has no documentation
  --> tests/fixtures/jetdoc/undocumented.jet:3:5
    |
  3 | pub fn undocumented() {}
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: generated reference documentation needs a summary for every public API item so users can find and understand the supported surface.
 Fix: add a `///` summary before `undocumented`, or remove `pub` when it is not part of the public API.
